topicFamilies.label: Upper-airway / hypoglossal nerve stimulation for OSA
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: AASM surgical-referral guidance supplies current U.S. referral context but is not a device-specific HNS eligibility guideline. FDA labeling controls each approved device's indication/contraindication boundaries. ERS is current specialty support. No single device's numeric criteria are universal.

topicFamilies.label: Positional therapy for position-dependent OSA
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: ERS 2021 provides current specialty-guideline support for positional therapy. The 2009 AASM adult OSA guideline is legacy/applicable context only; do not present it as a newer dedicated positional-therapy authority.

topicFamilies.label: Weight management and OSA-directed pharmacotherapy awareness
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: Weight management is part of comprehensive OSA care. FDA labeling controls the approved tirzepatide indication; qualified clinicians control prescribing and monitoring. ATS provides specialty guideline support. Older AASM 2009 material remains contextual, while current AASM guidance controls where applicable.

topicFamilies.label: Bariatric-surgery referral context in adult OSA
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: Current AASM surgical-referral guidance governs the referral discussion. ATS/ERS sources are supporting specialty context, not replacements for the AASM referral guideline.
